_source: Shared reference-led creator builder, revised after the October 2026 output audits (fix-forward 15 Oct: phone capture, deep focus, no bokeh, real unretouched skin, no forced flaws). Prompt requests guide generation; they do not establish content acceptance.

slots.identity: the person chosen in the approved brief
slots.imperfections: ordinary texture; distinctive marks only when explicitly chosen
slots.framing: camera height, visible body area, headroom and action space
slots.scene: the actual approved setting and background
slots.focus: deep focus by default; shallow only when the reference is shot that way

negative_prompt: waxy skin, beauty filter, airbrushing, skin smoothing, plastic gloss, painted acne scars, greasy shine, exaggerated pore craters, sharpening halos, cinematic colour grade, artificial grain overlay, bokeh background, portrait mode blur, shallow depth of field, ring light, beauty lighting, plain studio backdrop, white void, doll proportions, malformed hands, extra fingers, dead glassy eyes, cropped face, invented text, logos, watermarks, nude, bare shoulders, topless
